answer: Agents use a prism sensor to measure water clarity by a jetty and vote on where to dredge the inlet. The contract gives one vote per token escrowed before the proposal opens. It verifies the voter owns the deposit, counts each deposit once per proposal, and keeps it locked until the vote closes. A hundred tokens split among a hundred aliases still yield a hundred votes. To double that influence, an attacker has to acquire and lock another hundred tokens.
